metadata.description: Toolkit V2: the toolkit plugin, whose project-setup skill sets up and updates one solo developer's projects in Claude Code and Codex. The agent runs the project; the owner decides and steers.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Sets up Toolkit V2 in a project, or moves a project from the older toolkit onto it: copies the project files, work and memory skills with the selected storage references, and the hooks.
